what:
cargo, follow-up to 01541 part 2 (docs/cargo.md ~line 415). The example table, copied as written, is refused at load: its `${LLVM_SYS_231_PREFIX}/lib` entry has no `build-script-env` listing the variable. It also uses LLVM, the one case that must not use this feature (the pinned LLVM is already in a SYSTEM dir; see docs/contributing.md). Replace the table's link-dirs line with these two lines:
build-script-link-dirs = ["/opt/vendor/lib", "${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib"]   # rustc-link-search may name
build-script-env = ["OPENSSL_DIR"]                                   # a ${NAME} above must be listed here

history.note: docs/cargo.md sandbox example uses ${OPENSSL_DIR}/lib with build-script-env = ["OPENSSL_DIR"], as given
